items.title: Lee Sun-kyun
items.summary: Lee Sun-kyun was a South Korean actor. He played Park Dong-ik in Bong Joon-ho's Academy Award-winning movie Parasite (2019). He won a Screen Actors Guild Award for his acting in that movie. Lee was born in Seoul, South Korea.

items.title: Claire Forlani
items.summary: Claire Antonia Forlani is an English movie performer who also stars on TV programs. She starred in the movie Meet Joe Black in 1998. and Mystery Men in 1999. She also starred in other movies.
